# SIGNAL ROLES - who may be edited (generated by tools/audit-roles.js, v1.18.x WIP)

Why: in a real plant the operator changes the SV, the manual values and the switches; the PV and the feedbacks are the plant answering. The simulator has no plant, so every field point is an input unless the plant model drives it. This table classifies EVERY field / operator side point of the 51 sheets (transmitters = AI blocks, SIG.AB flags, external input wires) with the description of the IO list / memory list (the files the user gave).
